theorems.name: Submission.c1_sard_coarea_jacobian_eq_zero_iff
theorems.statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (x : Rn N), coareaJacobian M f x = 0 ↔ Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range ((fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (tangentSpace M x).subtype)) < m
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
